title: 长剑破膝打击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：左、上、左、右。左击、上段斩后，从左侧以刺击攻击对手膝部。
second_page: 长剑破膝打击的前两击要把敌人的防守带高，后续攻击才落向关节。翻到这里，你已经开始练习长剑破膝打击。

en_us.title: Knee Strike: Longsword
en_us.first_page: Input: Left, Up, Left, Right. Use a left and overhead strike to draw the guard high, then attack the knee from the left.
en_us.second_page: The opening blows must lift the enemy's defense before the following attack drops into the exposed joint.
